provenance_note: All 1521 checks are recomputed by the reference; no stored value is reused.
reference: Independent python reference written by a second agent from a method specification and the case files only, without access to the page code: a loop-flow Newton solver (Hardy Cross family, one virtual reservoir node linking the fixed-pressure nodes), cross-checked by a node-pressure Newton solver with exact per-component inversion (agreement 1.9e-11 relative or better) and by closed forms for the single-component and two-in-series cases (1.5e-13 or better). Every case input is stored in benchmarks/ductnetwork.reference.json.
reference_citations: P.K. Swamee & A.K. Jain, "Explicit equations for pipe-flow problems", ASCE J. Hydraulics Div. 102(HY5) (1976) 657-664: f = 0.25/[log10(eps/(3.7 D) + 5.74/Re^0.9)]^2, stated for 1e-6 <= eps/D <= 1e-2 and 5e3 <= Re <= 1e8.

H. Cross, "Analysis of Flow in Networks of Conduits or Conductors", Univ. of Illinois Eng. Exp. Station Bulletin 286 (1936): the loop-correction method dQ = -sum(h)/sum(|dh/dQ|) used by the second solver.
C.F. Colebrook, J. Inst. Civ. Eng. 11 (1939) 133-156: used only to quantify the Swamee-Jain scatter, never as the graded reference.
ASHRAE Handbook - Fundamentals, Duct Design: rectangular hydraulic diameter Dh = 2WH/(W+H); local loss dp = K rho v^2/2.
Fan affinity law dp ~ n^2 applied to the two-point quadratic fan curve.

tolerance.en: Pass if |page - reference| <= max(1e-6 x |reference|, abs), where abs is ten times the first-order bound of the page's own convergence gate (scaled residual 2e-9) propagated through the scaled Jacobian of each case; friction-factor grid 1e-12 relative; status, refusal kind, warnings and import counts exact.
tolerance.uk: Перевірку пройдено, якщо |сторінка - еталон| <= max(1e-6 x |еталон|, abs), де abs — десятикратна межа першого порядку власного критерію збіжності сторінки (масштабований залишок 2e-9), перенесена через масштабований якобіан кожного випадку; сітка коефіцієнта тертя — 1e-12 відносно; статус, вид відхилення, попередження та лічильники імпорту — точно.
tolerance.de: Bestanden, wenn |Seite - Referenz| <= max(1e-6 x |Referenz|, abs), wobei abs das Zehnfache der Schranke erster Ordnung des eigenen Konvergenzkriteriums der Seite (skaliertes Residuum 2e-9) ist, fortgepflanzt über die skalierte Jacobi-Matrix jedes Falls; Reibungszahl-Raster 1e-12 relativ; Status, Abweisungsart, Warnungen und Importzähler exakt.
tolerance.nl: Geslaagd als |pagina - referentie| <= max(1e-6 x |referentie|, abs), waarbij abs tien keer de eersteordegrens is van het eigen convergentiecriterium van de pagina (geschaald residu 2e-9), doorgerekend via de geschaalde Jacobiaan van elk geval; wrijvingsfactorraster 1e-12 relatief; status, soort weigering, waarschuwingen en importaantallen exact.
tolerance.fr: Réussi si |page - référence| <= max(1e-6 x |référence|, abs), où abs vaut dix fois la borne du premier ordre du propre critère de convergence de la page (résidu mis à l'échelle 2e-9), propagée par le jacobien mis à l'échelle de chaque cas ; grille de coefficients de frottement 1e-12 en relatif ; statut, type de refus, avertissements et comptes d'import exacts.
tolerance.es: Pasa si |página - referencia| <= max(1e-6 x |referencia|, abs), donde abs es diez veces la cota de primer orden del propio criterio de convergencia de la página (residuo escalado 2e-9), propagada a través del jacobiano escalado de cada caso; malla de factores de fricción 1e-12 relativo; estado, tipo de rechazo, advertencias y recuentos de importación exactos.
tolerance.pl: Zaliczone, jeśli |strona - wzorzec| <= max(1e-6 x |wzorzec|, abs), gdzie abs to dziesięciokrotność oszacowania pierwszego rzędu własnego kryterium zbieżności strony (skalowane residuum 2e-9), przeniesionego przez skalowaną macierz Jacobiego każdego przypadku; siatka współczynnika tarcia 1e-12 względnie; status, rodzaj odrzucenia, ostrzeżenia i liczniki importu dokładnie.

tolerance_detail.rule: pass if |page - ref| <= max(rel * |ref|, abs) where abs is the per-key value in each case's abs_tolerance_from_page_stopping_rule (when present) or the default abs below

q.why: page continuity rows hold to 2e-9*q_s and energy rows to 2e-9*h_s*rho*g; the per-key abs value is 10x the first-order bound |J_s^-1|*2e-9 of the page's scaled system at the solution, so it covers near-zero-flow branches.

dp_loss.why: energy rows hold to 2e-9*h_s*rho*g (>= 1.2e-7 Pa at h_s 5 m); per-key abs propagates the q bound through d(loss)/dq.

v.why: v = |q|/A: same relative accuracy as q.

Re.why: Re = v Dh/nu: same relative accuracy as q.

f.why: |dlnf/dlnRe| <= 1 on every branch, so f carries at most the relative error of q.

node.p.why: free-node pressures inherit the energy-row residual 2e-9*h_s*rho*g accumulated along a path; fixed nodes are inputs (exact).

boundary_q.why: sum of incident flows: abs = sum of their q bounds.

f.<i> (friction grid).why: closed-form evaluation in double precision; only round-off differs (log10 and pow).

doc.<lang>.label.<field>.basis, doc.<lan.why: enum total|static|mixed|unstated (method.md s.10, A5); a classification of page text, so no numeric tolerance applies.

status, refusal_kind, warnings, imported.why: discrete outputs; warnings compared as a set of {kind, sorted components}.

process: Phase 1: a driver agent wrote the stored case inputs, the method specification and the page driver, and wrote no expected values. Phase 2: a second agent wrote the reference from the case inputs and the specification only, without access to the page code. Phase 3: the page outputs were graded against the reference with the reference tolerances unchanged; disputed points were adjudicated against the specification and every correction is recorded in the reference file.

reference_decisions.why: Reading of method.md s.6; used only to size tolerances.

reference_concerns.concern: First issue: the energy balance carried rho g z with boundary pressures gauge to the local atmosphere, giving a 141.66 Pa spurious drive over 12 m and reversing the riser (q = -0.795 m3/s). The revision uses (rho - rho_out) g z with rho_out = rho; the riser now flows up at +1.241 m3/s, the value this reference gave for the term-free case.

reference_concerns.status: resolved by method.md rev. 2026-10-15 (residual note kept)
reference_concerns.concern: The curve is now stated everywhere as the fan total-pressure rise, which is consistent with its use in a total-pressure energy balance. Remaining note: a user entering a manufacturer static-pressure curve must add the fan outlet velocity pressure first; the model has no outlet area, so it cannot do or check that.

The quadratic curve continued to q<0 rises without bound: at the solved reverse flow (-4.624 m3/s) the fan 'adds' 3693 Pa, 5.3 times its 700 Pa shutoff pressure. A real fan driven backwards acts as a throttle; the value is a model extrapolation (the page warns fan_reverse).

Inside the published box Swamee-Jain deviates from Colebrook by up to 2.83 % (Re 5000, eps/Dh 0.01; 2.12 % at Re 1e4, eps/Dh 0.01); the 2000-4000 smoothstep is a numerical bridge with no published basis. Both are graded as specified.

reference_concerns.where: method.md s.4 damper equal law, case damper_equal_openings
reference_concerns.concern: c = 50^(o-1) gives c = 0.0201 at 0.1 % opening, so the 'almost closed' damper still passes 2.0 % of its full-open flow at the same pressure difference (0.0226 m3/s at 80 Pa); this is the inherent rangeability 50 of the law, stated here so the figure is not read as leakage data.
